head.name: @fzlt/core/cards
head.lead: A deck of cards for tabletop games. Cards are numbers 0..size−1 (the game says what each one is); every card is in exactly one pile, at one place in it, face up or down. shuffle(pile, seed), draw, deal to hands, move, flip, gather piles back. - The shuffle is a Fisher-Yates over a 32-bit integer generator with rejection sampling (no modulo bias), so the same seed gives the same order in every browser: both online players see the same deck. - Each change stamps the card with the deck's clock, so a drawing helper animates the moves in the order they were made. - dioramaCards builds the deck into an @fzlt/core/diorama scene: each card a thin card-shaped prism with its face or back painted on the side that looks at the camera (by your callbacks: the game paints its own art), laid out per pile as a stack, a row on the table, or a hand fanned toward the camera; moves fly in arcs, flips turn over, staggered in move order. pick names the card under a point. No allocation per deck operation, show() or draw in the steady state.

sizesNote: Measured on this build: minified and gzipped with everything it imports, the way npm run size checks the budget in CI.
